title: Prime Spot Minutes to 12 South, Gulch & Broadway
description:
Experience Nashville in style at this stunning 4-bedroom home in the heart of 8th Ave South! Perfect for groups up to 12, this luxurious space features an open-concept layout with premium amenities. Walk to live music, grab morning coffee at 8th & Roast, or catch comedy at Zanies…all steps away. Minutes to The Gulch, 12 South, and Broadway, this home is your central hub to everything that makes Nashville amazing. Comfort meets convenience for the ultimate Nashville adventure!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
